title: New York University
description: NYU's official brand guidelines define the primary colours NYU Violet (#57068C), Ultra Violet (#8900E1) and Black (#000000), with the secondary colours Deep Violet (#330662), Medium Violet 1 (#702B9D), Medium Violet 2 (#7B5AA6), Light Violet 1 (#AB82C5) and Light Violet 2 (#EEE6F3).
